name: Oil and Commodity Price-Cap and Ship-to-Ship Evasion
description: Where price caps or embargoes apply to oil and other commodities, attempts to circumvent them may involve inflated or opaque attestations, intermediary traders, undisclosed ship-to-ship transfers and ageing or unusual tankers. Detection draws on trade documents, pricing, vessel data and the quality of attestations from counterparties.

sources.text: FinCEN and BIS, Joint Alert: FinCEN and the US Department of Commerce's BIS Urge Increased Vigilance for Potential Russian and Belarusian Export Control Evasion Attempts (FIN-2022-Alert003, June 2022)
Price Cap Coalition, Advisory for the Maritime Oil Industry and Related Sectors (2023)
OFSI/HM Government, UK Maritime Services Ban and Oil Price Cap Industry Guidance
